author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus (DBS Remaster) is coming to us all in the Fall of 2026. Along with a substantial upgrade to the animation in places, we expect that several minor and significant changes could be coming to the story. How far will this remaster reinvent the story of Super? Let's find out. 

MUSIC CREDITS:
Super covers by Pokemixr92 and GLADIUS
title: Every Change in Dragon Ball Super's Remaster
